ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd"}
ti["F"] = {"st_fake_quake"}
ti["T"] = {"st_timer", target="timer_handler"}
ti["@"] = {"ac_marble", 0.5, 1.0}

w, h = wo(ti, " ", {
    "T#-#################",
    "#O   D      -    @O#",
    "#O   D      -      #",
    "#F   D      --     #",
    "#O   &             #",
    "#F & d   -         #",
    "#O   &     -       #",
    "#O   D -           #",
    "#F   D -  D        #",
    "#O   D -  D  -     #",
    "#F   D             D",
    "#O   D -  -        D",
    "##-##D###########DDD"})

mytimer = 0

function timer_handler()
    mytimer = mytimer + 1
    if mytimer == 1 then
        wo["GlobalForce"] = po(20.0, 20.0)
    end
    if mytimer == 2 then
        wo["GlobalForce"] = po(-20.0, -20.0)
    end
    if mytimer == 3 then
        wo["GlobalForce"] = po(20.0, -20.0)
    end
    if mytimer == 4 then
        wo["GlobalForce"] = po(0.0, 0.0)
        wo["GlobalForce"] = po(-20.0, 20.0)
        no["door"]:toggle()
        mytimer = 0
    end
end

wo:shuffleOxyd()

texts.text1: Take some money and build yourself the tools you need.
The other document lies and the left wormhole is the right one.
texts.text2: The other document tells the truth and the other wormhole has been left on the right side.

texts.text1: Just a hint: Try the easy-mode first ...
texts.text2: Don't think too long ... it's easy!

    "#       O  O       #",

wo:add({"ot_timer", target="snow", interval=0.2})
wo:shuffleOxyd({no["oxyds#*"]:sort("circular"), circular=true})

local lawngrp = no["lawn#*"]:shuffle()

function snow()
    flake = lawngrp:sub(1)
    wo[flake] = {"fl_ice"}
    lawngrp = lawngrp - flake
end
